articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: Putin Fuels 'Doomsday' Fears — Russian Leader Boasts About Unstoppable Nuclear Torpedo That Would 'Swallow Everything'
articles.summary: Russian President Putin boasted about the successful test of a new unmanned vehicle, claiming its speed and depth of movement are unparalleled globally. He asserted that this advanced technology is unmatched, indicating a significant leap in Russia's military capabilities. This development, likely an advanced underwater drone or submarine, underscores Russia's ambition to lead in specific defence technologies, enhancing its strategic advantage.

articles.title: Pacifist Japan has slowly transformed from exclusively self-defense to a military buildup
articles.summary: Japan is significantly boosting its military capabilities, planning to double annual arms spending to counter China's growing threats. This strategic shift reflects Tokyo's commitment to enhanced self-reliance and a stronger defense posture. For SSB aspirants, this highlights evolving Indo-Pacific geopolitics and the critical importance of national defense preparedness.

articles.title: China says live-fire drills around Taiwan 'completed successfully'
articles.summary: International criticism mounts over China's military exercises near Taiwan. Japan specifically voiced concerns on Wednesday, stating the drills "increase tensions" across the Taiwan Strait. This situation highlights ongoing regional security challenges and geopolitical sensitivities concerning Taiwan, crucial for understanding Indo-Pacific dynamics.

articles.title: Finnish authorities seize vessel following sea cable disruption
articles.summary: A telecommunications cable connecting Helsinki (Finland) and Tallinn (Estonia), owned by Elisa, was reported damaged on Wednesday. Finnish authorities are investigating the incident, with the Border Guard locating a suspicious vessel near the site. This event underscores the fragility of critical international undersea infrastructure and could raise concerns regarding maritime security and potential causes.
